name: cortico-world-agent-wechat-native
description:
把 NAS 上的 agent-wechat 接入 Coo：微信私聊和群聊各自成为独立会话，共用同一套模型、人格和 Memory。

- 订阅 daemon 的 SSE 事件流，断线按游标续传，不重复交付同一条消息。
- 每个联系人和群聊各有自己的上下文，互不串号；群聊里区分是谁在说话。
- 发文字、引用回复、@群成员；发送带幂等键，超时后先查发送记录，不盲目重发。
- 图片、文件、视频、语音先上传拿 source ID 再发送，不把大文件塞进正文。

en.description:
Connects Coo to an agent-wechat daemon on your NAS: every WeChat direct chat and group is its own conversation, sharing one model, persona and Memory.

- Subscribes to the daemon's SSE stream, resumes from a cursor and never delivers the same message twice.
- Each contact and group keeps its own context; a group keeps who said what.
- Sends text, quote replies and group mentions; every send carries an idempotency key, and an uncertain outcome is looked up rather than resent.
- Images, files, video and voice upload first and send by source ID instead of stuffing bytes into a message.
